prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth UI redesign
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for default login state and required auth flows only.
Primary request: Redesign 02-A-02-login/default.
Direction: minimal secure login card.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve welcome message, subtle study/mascot support area, email field, password field, password/magic-link tabs, remember-me checkbox, forgot-password link, dark primary login CTA, Google login, and sign-up link. No error or expired-session banner.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design auth Form/Card/Tabs/Button UI, compact and accessible.
Color palette: #f4f4f5 background, #ffffff form card, #ececee dividers/chips, #09090b primary CTA, #71717a helper text.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, no letter spacing, weight-driven hierarchy.
Constraints: authentication task must be primary; secondary actions must not compete with CTA; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, gradients, neon, multi-color login buttons beyond provider mark, raw provider errors, captcha/lockout inventions, watermark.
